name: Unemail (Open-Source Email API Library)
free_limit: MIT-licensed TypeScript library for a unified email-sending API across SMTP and supported third-party providers; no software subscription or usage quota imposed by the library.
watch_out: This is a developer library, not a hosted email service. SMTP infrastructure and third-party delivery providers (such as SES, Resend, or Postmark) have separate pricing, quotas, account requirements and possible overage charges.
